from array import array
items = [
 (0b1001100110010, 89, "q00"),
 (0b1101111000000110, 429, "q01"),
 (0b10001111000100, 247, "q02"),
 (0b10111001110001, 565, "q03"),
 (0b1101100101011010, 61, "q04"),
 (0b11010011101011001, 580, "q05"),
 (0b11111101100010, 971, "q06"),
]
full = (1<<17)-1
nn=len(items); size=1<<nn
unions = array('I', bytes(4*size)); costs = array('H', bytes(2*size))
best=None; bm=0
for mk in range(size):
    low=mk&-mk; i=low.bit_length()-1; prev=mk^low
    u=unions[prev]|items[i][0]; unions[mk]=u
    c=costs[prev]+items[i][1]; costs[mk]=c
    if u==full:
        key=(c,mk.bit_count())
        if best is None or key<best: best=key; bm=mk
print("array brute", best, "mask", bin(bm))
print("check bm union", bin(unions[bm]))
